articles.title: AAP Plans Agitation Over Stalled Burari Road Project Construction
articles.description: AAP MLA Sanjeev Jha will lead a protest at PWD Minister Parvesh Verma's residence on November 17, demanding answers on why the Burari 100-foot road construction tender was cancelled despite earlier assurances and successful bidding.

articles.title: BNCMC's 10-Year PPP Plan For 57-Bed BGP Hospital Raises Concerns Over Affordable Healthcare
articles.description: Bhiwandi's civic body has invited bids to run its new 57-bed BGP Hospital under a 10-year public-private partnership. The November 5 tender estimates the contract at ₹4 crore and allows a 15% rate rise every three years. Local representatives Manoj Shrivastav and Dr Intikhab Alam raised concerns over affordable treatment and warned of protests against the proposal.

articles.title: BSF Issues ₹49.3 Lakh Tender for Drone Simulation and Maintenance Facility in Bengaluru
articles.description: The proposed facility will incorporate computer-based drone simulation systems, virtual reality equipment and associated training infrastructure. The procurement covers nine categories of equipment and services, comprising a total quantity of 45 units.
